bridges.gap_ownership: positioning/structural (short-covering squeeze) - NOT chain_drift. At record-short exhaustion the short-crowding realized as an overnight covering GAP UP (+45), unrealized-ahead carry that pushed the reopen. This is why the down day did not fully deliver: the gap up and the resumed sell tape roughly cancel.

bridges.monday_bias_confirmed_or_adjusted: CONFIRM down direction (E right: sellers resume, turn_down + aligned ph2 sell) but ADJUST magnitude STRONGLY DOWN to NEAR-FLAT / two-sided. bridges.why: the reopen gap-up (covering not spent) is a magnitude killer, not a direction flipper: down direction holds because sellers reasserted with aligned conviction, but they only recover the covering gap - net the day is roughly flat. This is the exact cascade case where keying off the gap sign (up) would mis-lead Monday; keying off the exit-state (spent covering, sellers resume) keeps direction right while the observed covering gap sizes it small.
